tools.name: search_mindmaps
tools.description: Find mindmaps by title. With query: substring or in-order fuzzy match. Without query: lists maps newest-first. Returns { maps: [{ id, title, rev, modified }] }.

query.description: Title keywords. Omit to list maps.

tools.name: create_mindmap
tools.description: Create a map from a nested outline in one call. Returns { id, rev, node_count }. Prefer edit_mindmap when the map already exists.

outline.description: Nested tree; each node is { t, c[] }.

layout.description: Layout applied to seeded clusters: balanced, treeRight, treeDown, radial, timeline, free.

template.description: Default style template id for the document.

tools.name: outline_mindmap
tools.description: Compact tree of a map: nodes as { i, t, c[] }; a subtree hidden by depth or a collapsed node reports { +n } (hidden descendant count) instead of c. Returns { map_id, rev, layout, nodes, edges, roots, free }, where free lists non-tree elements as { i, kind, t? }. Read before editing to keep context small.

depth.description: Levels to expand; deeper descendants collapse into +n.

tools.name: find_in_map
tools.description: Full-text search within one map. Returns { rev, hits: [{ i, t, path }] }, where path is the ancestor breadcrumb. The entry point into a large map.

tools.name: read_elements
tools.description: Full detail for selected elements. Provide ids (max 100), OR subtree_of (a node + its subtree), OR kinds. Returns { map_id, rev, elements: [{ i, kind, content, style?, x?, y?, collapsed?, pinned?, w?, h? }], edges: [{ e, a, b, kind, label? }] }. content uses the storage $type shape.

subtree_of.description: Read a node and its whole subtree.

kinds.description: Filter to kinds: node, shape, text, image, frame.

tools.name: edit_mindmap
tools.description: Apply an atomic op batch (all-or-nothing) using the rev from outline/find/read. Each op has an 'op' field. add {under?, after?, nodes:[{t|content, c[], ref?}]} inserts nested subtrees (no under = new cluster). set {id, t?|content?, style?, clear_style?, collapsed?, pinned?, wh?}. move {id, under, after?} or {id, xy:[x,y]}. del {ids:[]}. link {a, b, label?, style?, ref?}. unlink {edge} or {a, b}. set_edge {edge, label?, style?, clear_style?}. style_subtree {root|ids, style}. layout {root?, algo?, template?, options?}. add_el {kind, xy:[x,y], content, wh?, ref?}. frame {id, add?:[], remove?:[]}. content and style are the storage $type/token shapes; ref keys map to created ids in the result. Returns { rev, created, deleted }. Errors: rev_conflict (contended_ids), not_found (suggestions), would_cycle, bad_content_type, validation_error, each with failed_op_index.

rev.description: Revision the ops were composed against (from outline/find/read).

content.description: Typed content ($type: text, task, code, math, link, note, flashcard, image, shape, freeText, canvasImage, frame).

kind.description: Element kind for add_el: shape, text, image, frame.

ref.description: Caller key returned in created -> id.
